uniteDbPokemon.notes: Batch-01 mechanics survey used descriptions, true_desc, notes, buffs, cooldowns, levels, and formulas from this public JSON.

passiveEffects.name: Huge Power
passiveEffects.originalDescription: When this Pokémon hits only a single enemy with a basic attack, a move, or their Unite Move, the hit is always a critical hit. However, when hitting two or more enemies at once with a basic attack, a move, or its Unite Move, the hits are never critical hits. When this Pokémon hits only a single enemy with an auto attack, a move, or their Unite Move, the hit is always a critical hit. However, when hitting two or more enemies at once with an auto attack, a move, or its Unite Move, the hits are never critical hits. Critical hits deal 170% rather than 200%.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Belly Bash
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: Azumarill pounds their belly 3 times, granting a shield. With each pound, Azumarill loses HP in exchange for increased Attack. Azumarill can move while pounding their belly. Afterward, target an enemy and then charge at the target; dealing damage to them and throwing all enemies hit while charging. Azumarill targets an enemy player and then pounds their belly three times; losing 5% remaining HP with each pound in exchange for a 6.5% max HP shield that stacks with each pound and lasts 6s. Azumarill gains increased attack for 8s and can move while pounding their belly. Azumarill then charges at the target damaging and throwing all Pokémon hit while charging and Pokémon within the area effect around the target. Azumarill is unstoppable during this move. Unite buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
